items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; world scrolls, character screen-centered; speed ≈75–80px/s; diagonal movement normalized/slower per axis. LMB = Primary (pick/examine); hovering shows verb labels at long range (200–300px+), so hover to scout before walking. Pick requires roughly ≤100–130px; ~150px borderline, ≥200px fails. Standing directly on a target flips Pick→Examine—step off and retry. Clicking a target that is within/near range makes the character auto-walk and pick. Tab toggles Map. Q/E rotate camera, scroll zooms. Esc = Pause menu (Continue/Controls/Settings/Save and Quit); Continue needs a click. Esc while craft panel open closes the panel AND opens pause. Caps Lock (craft panel) cannot be sent as an input here—open craft via mouse click on sidebar icons. Hotbar keys 1–0 select slots; pressing the key holding food consumes/eats it (Seeds disappeared after pressing 2). Hotbar has more slots than 0 reaches—a torch in a late slot could not be unequipped by key and kept burning in daylight. Hotbar counts sometimes lag one pick; icons eventually update.

CRAFT UI (observed): flame/Light icon at ≈(0.02,0.18); Tools at y≈0.10–0.145. Clicking a sidebar icon switches category. Dark silhouette tiles = unaffordable/locked and click silently fails; bright tile = craftable. Clicking a bright recipe opens a popup listing costs (green when met) with a Build button (≈0.28,0.67). Craft panel does NOT pause time; movement works while it is open. Recipes seen: Tools (pickaxe/axe bright, others padlocked—likely need Science Machine). Light: torch, campfire, firepit silhouettes; campfire/firepit stayed dark even with 2 Grass+2 Twigs. TORCH RECIPE CONFIRMED: 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs.

TORCH (observed): crafted at 96% durability, burning ~8–9% per 3s wait (~3%/s ⇒ ≈30s of light). Burns while equipped even in daylight. Expiry message 'My light just ran out!'—harmless by day. Light restored visibility ('I can see again!').

NIGHT (observed): sequence = 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' → blue moon icon beside clock → scene visibly reddens → 'It's so dark!' → black screen, attackers with 'What was that?!'/'OW! Something hit me!' plus red damage vignette until death. With a lit torch through Night 1 (~10s real-time) took no damage and reached Day 2. Without light, death is near-certain. Night falls fast; the moon icon is the last practical crafting window.

HUNGER (observed): 'I'm so hungry!' warning; drumstick icon drains steadily. Pressing a food's hotbar key eats it (Seeds consumed). Petals hover 'Eat'; Red Mushrooms are pickable food; Seeds appear as ground sprites 'Pick up Seeds'. Whether each food restores meaningful hunger untested.

RESOURCES (observed): grass tuft→Cut Grass x1; sapling→Twigs x1; flower→Petals; berry bush→Berries. Depleted tufts read 'Examine Grass' (low stub); harvested saplings become bare branching twigs; flat ground twig sprites usually depleted 'Examine Sapling' but upright bare sprigs can still be fresh 'Pick Sapling'—always hover first. Pine trunks and needles read 'Examine Evergreen' and mimic tufts; aim precisely at the bright yellow cluster, not the trunk. Fresh grass is bright yellow-green and spiky; many pine-base tufts are already harvested. Best known fresh grass/red-mushroom cle aring was found far from the start, past pines. Butterflies/black birds inert so far; large red birds and a large winged crow present, hostility untested—avoid.

NAVIGATION (observed): start = burrow-heavy brown savanna, heavily depleted; pines sparse east/southeast, denser pine grove west/southwest (many depleted bases but some fresh). North/northeast led to pale/sandy, resource-poor biome with rocky edge. Map (Tab): green = forest, yellow/orange = sandy/rock; explored area is a small blob, nearly all world unknown.

FAILED/WASTEFUL (observed): clicking dark recipe tiles; hovering craft tiles/hotbar for tooltips; walking toward labels already out of range; standing on pickables; trusting stale hotbar counts; scavenging extra grass while holding zero twigs; searching during reddening dusk; assuming campfire affordable.

LESSONS (unverified): TWIGS are the bottleneck—secure ≥2 Twigs early from saplings near pines before collecting surplus grass. Craft a torch well before dusk (early/mid afternoon), since the panel costs time and the world darkens fast. A torch's ~30s is enough for one night (~10s), but keep a spare 2 Grass + 2 Twigs. Grab food (seeds, mushrooms, petals) when passing. Open questions: food hunger values; F attack effect; craft column scrolling; campfire/firepit costs; Science Machine availability; large-bird hostility; whether torch can be stowed without a key.
